english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for training, including the act of practising or developing skills.
Use this when coaching develops practical skills, performance, or athletic ability.

examples.english: I have to do training after work every day.
examples.traditional: 我每日放工都要做訓練。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 fong3 gung1 dou1 jiu3 zou6 fan3 lin6

examples.english: The coach says this month's coaching will focus more on fitness.
examples.traditional: 教練話今個月嘅訓練會加強體能。
examples.jyutping: gaau3 lin6 waa6 gam1 go3 jyut6 ge3 fan3 lin6 wui5 gaa1 koeng4 tai2 nang4
